issue: The Disposition form gives ADVERSE EVENT as the reason for discontinuation on 2014-02-08, but none of the AE records has an action taken recorded, so it is unclear which AE led to discontinuation.
query_text: The Disposition form records discontinuation due to ADVERSE EVENT on 2014-02-08 (Week 20). Last dose is recorded as 2014-01-31. None of the 11 adverse event records has 'Action Taken' completed. The only AE ongoing near the last dose is Application Site Pruritus, which started 2013-12-29 and ended 2014-02-19. Please confirm which adverse event(s) led to discontinuation and update 'Action Taken' on the relevant AE record(s), e.g. study drug withdrawn. If the reason for discontinuation is not an adverse event, please correct the Disposition form.

issue: Balance Disorder, Contusion and Application Site Pruritus are each recorded three times with identical start and end dates but different severity, and two records of each have an end date but outcome NOT RECOVERED/NOT RESOLVED.
query_text: Three adverse events are each recorded three times with the same start and end dates. Balance Disorder (2013-10-09 to 2013-11-15) is recorded as MODERATE/Not Recovered, MILD/Not Recovered and MILD/Recovered. Contusion (2013-10-15 to 2013-11-02) is recorded as MODERATE/Not Recovered, MILD/Not Recovered and MILD/Recovered. Application Site Pruritus (2013-12-29 to 2014-02-19) is recorded as MODERATE/Not Recovered, MILD/Not Recovered and MILD/Recovered. Records with outcome NOT RECOVERED/NOT RESOLVED would not normally have an end date. If these records show changes in severity over time, please enter the actual start and end date of each severity period and the matching outcome. If they are duplicates, please correct them.

issue: The Screening 1 laboratory samples are dated 2013-08-15, six days before the Screening 1 visit date of 2013-08-21.
query_text: The Screening 1 laboratory results (for example CK 218 U/L and ALT 15 U/L) have a collection date of 2013-08-15 09:15. The Screening 1 visit is recorded on 2013-08-21.
